statement: A text check over a parsed format must not skip any line it assumes the parser ignores; compare the raw bytes and refuse every character the two could read differently. 2026-11-09, #687, my own error twice: to compare an Action's runs: section, the validator split on \n and skipped lines matching ^\s*#. Round 4 hid steps after a lone CR, NEL, LS or PS, which YamlDotNet 5.3.0 also treats as line breaks. Round 5 then showed that a '#' line inside a run: | block is script, not a comment, and that JavaScript's \s matches U+00A0, which YAML does not treat as white space, so an NBSP-led line folded into a run: command and executed. Fix (#687): no line is skipped. Comments moved above runs:, the manifest must end with the canonical runs: text byte for byte, and those characters are refused anywhere in the file.
